props.gloss_en: [Rabban Gamliel] bathed on the first night after his wife died
[the students:] you taught us, our master, that a mourner is forbidden to bathe
Rabban Gamliel: I am not like other people -- I am delicate
and when his slave Tavi died, he accepted condolences for him
[the students:] you taught us, our master, that one does not accept condolences for slaves
Rabban Gamliel: my slave Tavi is not like all other slaves -- he was worthy
a groom, if he wishes to recite the Shema on the first night, recites
Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel: not everyone who wishes to assume the name may assume it
